caption:
U.K. net migration falls to lowest level since 1997, excluding pandemic

Net migration to the U.K. has fallen to its lowest level since 1997, excluding the pandemic. The drop was largely driven by fewer people arriving from outside the European Union. It reflects government action to restrict immigration after a public backlash.

Reported by The New York Times; FT; The Guardian. Written by AI.
